title: Neighborhood Explorer
shareTitle: Neighborhood Explorer — Draw a World of Your Own
description: Draw a home, wind a road through the grass, place favorite community landmarks, and watch a personal watercolor town come alive.
learningGoals: Practice controlled freehand drawing and path-making
Represent familiar places with simple map symbols
Explore spatial relationships among home, routes, nature, and community places
Make and revisit an open-ended neighborhood composition
interactionModel: draw a home and road with one finger, choose illustrated landmarks, then tap the watercolor map to place them
feedbackModel: warm recorded guidance, tactile sound cues, drawing-to-house magic, placement sparkles, and a living-world finale

modes.title: Build a Neighborhood
modes.skill: draw routes and place familiar landmarks
